title: Week 3
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. Two lunches and two dinners come from your freezer this week.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter is often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the label for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a serving of fajitas and some green sauce. The freezer is clear, so week 4 starts fresh.

have.name: Corn tortillas
have.note: about 12 in the old pack, plus most of the new one

mon.heads: Lunch and the taco topping both come from Sunday's prep.

tue.heads: Tonight, move one soup bowl from the freezer to the fridge for tomorrow.

wed.heads: Tonight, move the last carnitas portion and the second soup bowl to the fridge.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: 4 portions of Peruvian chicken, a double batch of green sauce, a tray of roasted sweet potatoes and peppers, rice, 3 hash breakfasts, oat clusters, 6 eggs
steps: Coat the chicken thighs in the Peruvian marinade. Heat the oven to 425°F.
Roast the hash on one sheet pan and the sweet potato and pepper tray on another for 25 minutes.
Air-fry the chicken at 380°F for 18 to 20 minutes (or roast it at 425°F for 25), then slice.
Cook 2½ cups of rice. Save 1½ cups in the fridge for Tuesday's fried rice.
Blend the double batch of green sauce.
Drop the oven to 325°F and bake the oat clusters for 15 to 18 minutes.
Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Pack 3 Peruvian bowls and 3 hash containers. Keep 1 chicken portion for Tuesday's fried rice.
Move one carnitas portion from the freezer to the fridge for Monday.

prep.title: Freezer moves
prep.makes: Thawed soup and carnitas for Wednesday through Friday
steps: Tuesday night: move one soup bowl to the fridge for Wednesday's lunch.
Wednesday night: move the last carnitas portion and the second soup bowl to the fridge.

peruvian-chicken.name: Peruvian lime-garlic chicken
steps: Mix the lime juice, garlic, spices, soy sauce, oil and salt, and coat the chicken. Marinate 30 minutes or overnight.
Air-fry at 380°F for 18 to 20 minutes in batches, or roast at 425°F for 25, until charred at the edges.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and split into 4 portions.
peruvian-chicken.tip: This week's new flavor. It turns into bowls, fried rice and Thursday's lunch.

green-sauce.name: Peruvian green sauce (double batch)
steps: Blend everything until smooth, or chop the cilantro, jalapeño and garlic very finely and stir them into the yogurt and feta.
Salt to taste and keep in a jar. It is good for 5 days.
green-sauce.tip: Goes on the bowls, the tacos, the fried rice and the carnitas bowl.

roast-tray.name: Roasted sweet potato and pepper tray
steps: Toss everything with the oil, chili powder and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, stirring once.
Cool and store in one container.

oat-clusters.name: Honey cinnamon oat clusters
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F.
Microwave the honey, peanut butter and oil for 20 seconds and stir smooth.
Toss with the oats, cinnamon and salt.
Press flat on a lined sheet pan and bake 15 to 18 minutes, turning once.
Cool completely, then break into clusters.

yogurt-bowl.name: Berry yogurt power bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries and their juice, then the oat clusters.
Add the peanut butter and a drizzle of honey.
yogurt-bowl.tip: Good fuel about 90 minutes before pickleball.

sweet-potato-hash.name: Sweet potato sausage hash with eggs
steps: Toss the sweet potato, pepper and onion with the oil and spices on a sheet pan and pinch the raw sausage over the top in small pieces.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, stirring once.
Split into 3 containers.
Each morning, reheat a portion and top it with 2 eggs fried in 3 minutes.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.

peruvian-bowl.name: Peruvian chicken bowl with green sauce
steps: Pack rice, roasted sweet potatoes and peppers, and chicken in each container.
Pack shredded romaine and green sauce on the side.
Reheat the bowl 2 minutes, then add the lettuce, sauce and a squeeze of lime.
peruvian-bowl.tip: All from Sunday's prep. Eat the third one by Thursday.

peruvian-fried-rice.name: Peruvian chicken fried rice
steps: Heat the oil until shimmering. Scramble the eggs and push them to the side.
Add the peas for 1 minute, then the cold rice. Press it flat and let it crisp 2 minutes.
Add the chicken, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss until hot.
Top with green onion and a drizzle of green sauce.
peruvian-fried-rice.tip: Peruvian kitchens really do this. It is called chaufa. Fifteen minutes after Tuesday pickleball.

carnitas-street-tacos.name: Carnitas street tacos with green sauce
steps: Crisp the carnitas in the hot cast iron with a splash of its juices, 4 to 5 minutes without stirring.
Warm the tortillas in the dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
Fill with carnitas, onion and cilantro, then finish with lime and green sauce.

carnitas-bowl.name: Carnitas rice bowl
steps: Crisp the carnitas in the cast iron for 4 minutes.
Warm the rice and the roasted vegetables.
Build the bowl and top with cheese, green sauce and lime.
carnitas-bowl.tip: Ten minutes after Thursday pickleball, mostly from Sunday's prep.

freezer-soup.name: Tortilla soup from the freezer
steps: Thaw the bowl in the fridge the night before.
Microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.
Top with cheese, green onion and a spoon of yogurt.

smash-bowl.name: Smash burger bowl with special sauce
steps: Stir the yogurt, ketchup, mustard and pickle brine together for the sauce.
Heat the cast iron until very hot. Add the beef balls with a slice of onion on each and smash them flat.
Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute more.
Pile romaine, tomatoes and pickles into bowls, top with the patties and drizzle with sauce.

chicken-fajitas.name: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and spices on a sheet pan in one layer.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, then broil 2 minutes to char the edges.
Squeeze the lime over everything.
Warm the tortillas and set out cheese, yogurt, avocado and cilantro so everyone builds their own.
